subject.title: ScreenCaptureKit transient-denial retry swallows cancellation (second attempt after cancel)

question: Does the new ad-hoc live `SCStreamErrorDomain` runner transcript satisfy the prior re-entry gate for the combined cancellation fix, or must signed true-TCC and live permission-probe proof still be provided before https://github.com/openclaw/Peekaboo/pull/290 can land?
rationale: The earlier closeout established an owner-controlled live-proof threshold, while the new evidence materially improves the runner proof but intentionally does not meet every stated condition.

options.title: Require the remaining live proof
options.body: Keep the prior gate and request signed true-TCC cancellation evidence plus the live permission-probe path before reviewing the combined PR for merge.

options.title: Accept the new runner proof
options.body: Treat the real production-runner SCStream failure, control run, cancellation result, and focused tests as sufficient for this narrowly scoped cancellation fix.

options.title: Explicitly waive the live gate
options.body: Document that deterministic production-helper tests and the submitted live runner transcript are sufficient for this cancellation-swallow family.

recommendation.title: Require the remaining live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the prior gate and request signed true-TCC cancellation evidence plus the live permission-probe path before reviewing the combined PR for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The report identifies this person as the source of the re-entry criteria that now require interpretation or waiver.
